description: This file implements a foreground service in an Android application, including activity control, notifications, and wake lock management.

classes.name: ForegroundService
classes.description: An Android service that runs in the foreground, managing notifications and wake locks, with an inner Controller activity class for control buttons.

classes.name: ForegroundService.Controller
classes.description: An inner class activity providing UI controls to start and stop the foreground service and manage alarms.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager when service is created.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup operations and removes notifications when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to start the service in foreground or background with or without wakelocks.

methods.name: releaseWakeLock
methods.description: Releases the wake lock if acquired.

methods.name: handleDestroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup on service destruction, including releasing wake locks and callbacks.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used in this service.
